quests.instruction: Listen to how it's said, then choose the pitch pattern you hear.
options: Fall-Rise Tone (Diplomatic Hedge - Polite Way of Saying Not Impressed)
quests.correctAnswer: Fall-Rise Tone (Diplomatic Hedge - Polite Way of Saying Not Impressed)
quests.hint: Calling something merely 'interesting' is a classic polite dodge. Listen for the pitch to dip and lift carefully.
quests.explanation: A fall-rise on 'interesting' is a diplomatic hedge - a polite way of avoiding real praise without sounding openly critical.
quests.modulationPattern: In feedback, a fall-rise on the key word softens honest criticism into a diplomatic hedge; a full falling tone delivers direct, enthusiastic approval.
